zh-TW: Recipe 與手動自動曝光共用 SDK 啟動入口；策略相同時沿用相機串流，僅在策略或測光模式改變時重啟並驗證設定。
隔離前一次自動曝光排隊中的成功／失敗事件，避免干擾新量測；保留 Recipe 目標、各 Channel ROI、曝光／Gain 限制及未收斂時的安全停止。
本次未延長逾時；軟體回歸測試不代表所有樣品或實機已完成收斂驗收。
en-US: Recipe and manual auto exposure share the native SDK entry; reuse acquisition when policy and metering match, restarting and verifying only when they change.
Isolate queued success/failure events from earlier AE runs; preserve Recipe targets, channel ROIs, exposure/gain limits and safe stopping when convergence fails.
Timeouts are unchanged; software regression tests do not establish convergence for every sample or replace hardware acceptance.

zh-TW: 新增「說明 → 檢查更新」，顯示目前版本、GitHub 新版與各版本的修改內容。
支援背景下載、設備安全關閉後安裝、更新 Python 套件、重新啟動及安裝失敗復原。
更新保留 Recipe、設備設定、校正檔及量測資料；量測、拍攝或後處理進行中禁止套用更新。
關於視窗加入本版修改說明；後續每次程式修改必須遞增版號並補上中英文更新紀錄。
en-US: Added Help → Check for Updates with installed/latest versions and changes in every newer release.
Added background downloads, installation after verified equipment shutdown, Python dependency preparation, restart and failed-install recovery.
Updates preserve recipes, equipment settings, calibration and measurement data; installation is blocked during measurement, capture or post-processing.
About now includes this release's changes; every subsequent code change must increase the version and include bilingual release notes.
